nodes.title: 提示词编辑器｜全程多参考｜第一段
widgets_values:
subject_definitions:
Use the enabled image, video, and audio labels selected from the connected @ or < completion menu to define each character, location, motion pattern, and named voice anchor. Treat only labels actually present in the current registry as valid; physical workflow slot numbers are not execution labels.

summary:
Create the opening segment of a continuous short drama and establish stable identities, visual relationships, voice assignments, and the central dramatic action.

retention_analysis:
Preserve identity-defining facial structure, hairstyle, costume silhouette, signature colors, props, environment relationships, and named voice anchors. End on a clear frame that can guide the next segment.

detailed_description:
[Shot 1] Establish the setting and required characters, then perform one concise dramatic beat with coherent blocking, camera movement, lighting, synchronized dialogue, and a readable ending pose.

overall_soundscape:
Keep each named character bound to the corresponding enabled audio anchor. Mix dialogue, ambience, and Foley clearly without clipping.

non_diegetic_music:
Use a restrained dramatic motif that supports the opening and resolves softly at the segment boundary.

nodes.title: 模式与模型选择｜多参考模式
提示词编辑器｜全程多参考｜第二段
widgets_values:
subject_definitions:
@上一段尾帧 is the opening continuity image reference for this segment. Preserve the identities, costumes, props, scene relationships, motion language, and named voice anchors defined by every other enabled reference in the connected registry.

summary:
Continue the same short-drama scene from the visual state shown by @上一段尾帧 while keeping all surviving multi-reference constraints active.

retention_analysis:
Use @上一段尾帧 to preserve the opening composition and temporal continuity. Do not redesign faces, hairstyles, costume silhouettes, signature colors, props, locations, or speaker-to-voice assignments established by the remaining references.

detailed_description:
[Shot 1] Open with a composition closely matching @上一段尾帧, then continue one coherent dramatic action beat with controlled blocking, camera movement, lighting, synchronized dialogue, and another readable ending pose.

overall_soundscape:
Continue dialogue, room tone, ambience, Foley, and every named voice anchor seamlessly without clipping.

non_diegetic_music:
Continue the established dramatic motif with a controlled rise and resolve softly at the next segment boundary.

nodes.title: 模式与模型选择｜多参考模式
提示词编辑器｜全程多参考｜第三段
widgets_values:
subject_definitions:
@第二段尾帧 is the opening continuity image reference for the final segment. Preserve the identities, costumes, props, scene relationships, motion language, and named voice anchors defined by every other enabled reference in the connected registry.

summary:
Continue from @第二段尾帧 and complete the short-drama scene while retaining the full multi-reference identity and sound design.

retention_analysis:
Use @第二段尾帧 to preserve the opening composition and temporal continuity. Keep all surviving character, wardrobe, prop, location, and voice-anchor constraints stable through the final frame.

detailed_description:
[Shot 1] Open with a composition closely matching @第二段尾帧, deliver the dramatic climax with coherent blocking and camera movement, then settle into a stable final composition.

overall_soundscape:
Bring dialogue, ambience, Foley, room tone, and named voice anchors to a clear final beat without clipping.

non_diegetic_music:
Complete the established motif with a restrained final resolution.

流程说明

properties.text: 第一段：全部启用素材进入 Ref2VA。后续尾帧优先追加到下一个空余图片编号：1 张原图时占 <Picture 2>，8 张原图时占 <Picture 9>；只有原图已满 9 张时才替换最后一个已启用图片。

widgets_values: 第一段：全部启用素材进入 Ref2VA。后续尾帧优先追加到下一个空余图片编号：1 张原图时占 <Picture 2>，8 张原图时占 <Picture 9>；只有原图已满 9 张时才替换最后一个已启用图片。

nodes.title: 流程说明

properties.text: 第二段：仍为多参考模式。图片少于 9 张时，第一段尾帧直接追加并使用别名 @上一段尾帧；图片已满 9 张时，才替换最后启用图片并继续占 <Picture 9>。这是 Ref2VA 开场画面参考，不是 I2VA 硬首帧。

widgets_values: 第二段：仍为多参考模式。图片少于 9 张时，第一段尾帧直接追加并使用别名 @上一段尾帧；图片已满 9 张时，才替换最后启用图片并继续占 <Picture 9>。这是 Ref2VA 开场画面参考，不是 I2VA 硬首帧。

nodes.title: 流程说明

properties.text: 素材容量：提供 9 图、3 视频、3 音频槽位，启用的混合文件最多 12。图片按已启用项压紧：若只启用物理槽位 1、3、6，第一段分别为 <Picture 1>、<Picture 2>、<Picture 3>。

widgets_values: 素材容量：提供 9 图、3 视频、3 音频槽位，启用的混合文件最多 12。图片按已启用项压紧：若只启用物理槽位 1、3、6，第一段分别为 <Picture 1>、<Picture 2>、<Picture 3>。

nodes.title: 断点续接说明

properties.text:
全局生成控制器同时驱动所有启用阶段的分辨率、时长、视频步数和音频步数；修改一次即可同步所有启用阶段。
阶段断点：默认选择“运行当前阶段并保存”。某段失败后，先确认 output/xyue_h3 下已有该段视频，再在对应“阶段续接选择”中切换为“跳过当前阶段，从保存视频续接”，选择保存文件后重新排队。选择保存视频时，该阶段生成器及其上游会被惰性跳过。阶段链固定为：生成器 → 检查点保存 → 阶段续接选择 → 尾帧截取。

widgets_values:
全局生成控制器同时驱动所有启用阶段的分辨率、时长、视频步数、音频步数和采样方式；修改一次即可同步所有启用阶段。采样预设档位（快速单次/均衡/高品质双段）是权威值，会覆盖下方独立采样参数；选择“自定义”后使用下方参数。
阶段断点：默认选择“运行当前阶段并保存”。某段失败后，先确认 output/xyue_h3 下已有该段视频，再在对应“阶段续接选择”中切换为“跳过当前阶段，从保存视频续接”，选择保存文件后重新排队。选择保存视频时，该阶段生成器及其上游会被惰性跳过。阶段链固定为：生成器 → 检查点保存 → 阶段续接选择 → 尾帧截取。

nodes.title: 流程说明

properties.text: 后续阶段规则相同：第二段尾帧优先占用下一图片位，满 9 图才替换最后启用图。例如仅启用物理槽位 1、3、6 时，尾帧追加为 <Picture 4>，不会替换槽位 6。混合素材仍不得超过 12，满 12 时需先停用一项视频或音频。
